classification.difficultyReason: Compare each pair using signed number order, including two negative values, and express the same comparison in words and symbols.

answer.worked: $3$ is to the right of $2$ on a number line, so $3$ is greater than $2$: $3>2$.
$-4$ is to the left of $0$ on a number line, so $-4$ is less than $0$: $-4<0$.
$-7$ is to the left of $-6$ on a number line, so $-7$ is less than $-6$: $-7<-6$.
$-9$ is to the right of $-13$ on a number line, so $-9$ is greater than $-13$: $-9>-13$.
$3$ is to the right of $-3$ on a number line, so $3$ is greater than $-3$: $3>-3$.
$-2$ is to the right of $-147$ on a number line, so $-2$ is greater than $-147$: $-2>-147$.
